card.name: Feeding tube and syringe steps
card.fires_on: The word tube (or the 'and' right after it) in nasogastric, NG, OG or gastrostomy tube administration directions. It also fires on other steps in preparing and giving a dose with a syringe or vial.

modes.label: Feeding tube wording
modes.description: The word tube, or the 'and' after it, in directions for giving a dose through a nasogastric or gastrostomy tube.
modes.example: attach the syringe to the NG or OG tube<< and>> administer the dispersion before it settles.

modes.label: Other handling steps
modes.description: Words in syringe, vial or transfer-set instructions, such as brand name pieces, degrees or a step-ending period.
modes.example: hold the needle/syringe at an angle of approximately 45<< degrees>>.
